# NeatNoter 2.7.6

## Features

- Updated to patch 7.5.
- Updated to Dalamud sdk 15.
- Added background color and transparency option to the overlay window. Fixed the note edit UI to scale properly with dalamud setting to change UI scaling.
- Updated the plugin icon.

If any bug if found, please report at: https://github.com/shadowkras/NeatNoter/issues/
